summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script downloads a tarball from a hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS URL (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/...), extracts it, chmods the extracted file to 0755, and links it into the package's bin/ entry so the CLI executes it. The download uses https.get with rejectUnauthorized:false, disabling TLS certificate validation, and no hash or signature check is performed on the fetched bytes. The source is not publisher-matched (bare IP rather than an @onescience-controlled domain), the URL is not version-pinned to a verifiable release artifact, and the delivered bytes are opaque and executable. On npm install this results in unverified, mutable, MITM-substitutable code being placed on the installer's machine in an auto-executable location.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
